prompt:
Scene:
A square cinematic matte-painting style illustration of the interior of the same spaceport's waiting lounge, view from the near end looking toward a curved panoramic window. Warm afternoon light comes through the window from the same powder-blue sky as the reference. Matte painting texture, light film grain.

Subject:
An atomic-age passenger lounge inside the art-deco spire terminal: chrome-trimmed teardrop armchairs in powder pink and turquoise, low chrome-legged tables with ivory tops, a curving sunken conversation pit in mustard-gold carpet, and a decorative starburst chandelier hanging from the rounded ceiling cove. Through the large curving window the silver finned rocket from the reference stands majestically on its gantry against the same terminal spire and observation dome. Two stylized passengers in pastel flight suits chat in the pit; a chrome-trimmed hostess in cadmium-red uniform walks past with a tray of martini-style pressurized drinks.

Important details:
The rocket silhouette in the window must match the reference exactly (three red stripes, same fin layout, same gantry). Furniture forms are bulbous, curved, ray-gun-gothic. Palette stays strict atomic-age: ivory, turquoise, cadmium red, bright yellow, powder pink, chrome. Illustration is matte painting, not photo. Figures stylized, not photoreal.

Use case:
Silver Rocket Terminal series shot 3 of 4, an interior moment tied to the reference via the window view.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no modern glass-box airport lounge, no smartphones, no photoreal faces, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, preserve the reference rocket visible through the window.
title: Waiting Lounge
description: Interior of the spaceport lounge with the reference rocket visible through the curving window.
